# Test Cases and Evaluation Results

*Generated by `python tests/build_test_doc.py` on 2026-11-05 (Python 3.12.3, Linux).*

## How to read this table

- **Actual result (static analyzer)** is *measured*: the analyzer was executed on the input shown.
- **AI result (Groq)** is only filled when `python tests/run_ai_tests.py` has been run with a valid `GROQ_API_KEY`. Until then it says *Not run*. No AI results are invented.
- **Status** is the static-analyzer verdict: PASS if every expected rule fired (or, for negative controls, nothing fired). It does **not** claim the AI explanation is correct.

**Static analyzer summary: 17/17 cases passed** (small, hand-written set; the rules were developed while looking at these cases, so this is a sanity check, not an accuracy estimate).

## Reproduce

```bash
python tests/run_static_tests.py          # static analyzer on all cases
python tests/run_false_positive_probe.py  # valid programs must stay clean
python tests/run_ai_tests.py              # needs GROQ_API_KEY
python tests/build_test_doc.py            # rebuild this file
```
